channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: A warming planet makes nor’easters & other storms more intense: Climate scientist Michael Mann
item.description: With its defunding of scientific infrastructure across the country, “the Trump administration is truly putting Americans in harm’s way.”

item.title: Supreme Court will hear Exxon’s effort to crush climate lawsuits
item.description: Justice Samuel Alito did not recuse himself from considering the petition, despite significant financial conflicts of interest in implicated cases.

item.title: US Forest Service stops issuing firefighter pants that contain PFAS, following ProPublica’s reporting
item.description: Despite knowing about the use of PFAS, officials with the Forest Service had not previously informed wildland firefighters about it.

item.title: 158 giant tortoises return to Galápagos island of Floreana after 180 years
item.description: The reintroduction of the tortoise, a keystone "ecosystem engineer," is vital for seed dispersal and habitat regeneration in Galápagos conservation.
